title.en: Add agents from the marketplace in one step
title.zh: 从智能体市场一步添加

description.en: Selecting an agent in the marketplace opens its setup form directly. Its version, platforms and links are shown beside the form, and version history and uninstall remain under Manage.
description.zh: 在智能体市场中选择智能体后，将直接进入配置页面；版本、平台与相关链接显示在页面右侧，版本历史与卸载仍可通过「管理」进入。

title.zh: 连接智能体界面风格统一

description.en: The add-agent pages now follow the app's light and dark themes.
description.zh: 添加智能体相关页面已与应用的浅色、深色主题保持一致。
